description:
This is an electrical wiring/schematic sheet showing the connections for BEL1-S and BEL2-S modules. 

**Device: BEL1-S**
- An I/O module with several connections including FREQ_SELECT, VBATTERY RTN, CHAIN_OUTPUT, SYNC, ENABLE, ADR_0, ADR_1, CANA_HI, CANA_LO, CANA_Shield, and CHAIN_SUPPLY. 
- **Connections:**
    - FREQ_SELECT (Pin 2)
    - VBATTERY RTN (Pin 7) connects to BEL RTN1.
    - CHAIN_OUTPUT (Pin 11) connects to BEL SYNC (Pin 10).
    - SYNC (Pin 3) connects to BEL SYNC (Pin 3).
    - ENABLE (Pin 1) is Not Connected (N/C).
    - ADR_0 (Pin 8) is Not Connected (N/C).
    - ADR_1 (Pin 9) is Not Connected (N/C).
    - CANA_HI (Pin 5) connects to CAN-A HI.
    - CANA_LO (Pin 6) connects to CAN-A LO.
    - CANA_Shield (Pin N/C) connects to CAN-A Shield.
    - CHAIN_SUPPLY (Pin 10)
    - Pin 4
- **Control/Monitoring:** The module interfaces with a CAN bus (CAN-A) and has synchronization (SYNC) and chain connections. 

**Device: BEL2-S**
- An I/O module with similar connections to BEL1-S, including FREQ_SELECT, VBATTERY RTN, CHAIN_OUTPUT, SYNC, ENABLE, ADR_0, ADR_1, CANA_HI, CANA_LO, CANA_Shield, and CHAIN_SUPPLY. 
- **Connections:**
    - FREQ_SELECT (Pin 2)
    - VBATTERY RTN (Pin 7) connects to BEL RTN1.
    - CHAIN_OUTPUT (Pin 11) connects to BEL SYNC (Pin 9).
    - SYNC (Pin 3) connects to BEL SYNC (Pin 4).
    - ENABLE (Pin 1) is Not Connected (N/C).
    - ADR_0 (Pin 8) is Not Connected (N/C).
    - ADR_1 (Pin 9) is Not Connected (N/C).
    - CANA_HI (Pin 5) connects to CAN-A HI.
    - CANA_LO (Pin 6) connects to CAN-A LO.
    - CANA_Shield (Pin N/C) connects to CAN-A Shield.
    - CHAIN_SUPPLY (Pin 10)
    - Pin 4
- **Control/Monitoring:** Similar to BEL1-S, it interfaces with a CAN bus (CAN-A) and has synchronization (SYNC) and chain connections. 

**Cross-References:**
- There are no explicit cross-references to other sheets in the visible area, except for generic statements in the title block.
